Name: Cute Bobbers
Author: kiwisprinkle
Description:
This mod changes every bobber to be just a bit cuter. Some are recolored from vanilla, but the rest I drew and colored myself :) This is my first mod, so if there's any issues please let me know!

You can change your bobber through the machine in Willy's shop, though please note that bobbers are unlocked progressively as you catch more and more fish. If there's a bobber you really like but you don't want to wait to unlock it, you can switch two of the bobbers in the asset file using a photo editing program to put the one you would like ahead of the others!

[b][u]New in 1.1:[/u]
[/b]Added the ability to toggle each bobber on or off so you can mix and match with vanilla or other bobber mods! I suggest using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url] for the best experience, and I've also included a reference photo to make seeing what's being changed a bit easier.
